weather.blurb: Triple digits again. Water bottle, shade, and an early start.

air.blurb: Fine for most of us. If your lungs are touchy, take it a little easy.

lake.blurb: Still close to full, and down just a touch from last week.

sun.blurb: Just over twelve hours of daylight, and the evenings keep getting shorter.
